SMTO-OBS-0001 — There's no saved Model output for this step

GUID: 5d06b647-31c3-4e30-85dc-f8b648f3c5f4
Slug: model-output-not-captured
Domain: OBS · Subsystem: obs

What happened

  • SMTO doesn't have a saved copy of the raw text the Model wrote for this step, so there's nothing to show here. Older steps from before SMTO saved this text can't be recovered.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Read the reply and open the step's other details in the activity under it, such as Tool output if it ran a command. Model output is only a debugging copy of the Model's raw text; the step's actual results are kept separately.
  2. Don't ask the Agent to run the Task again just to see this text. Running it again would repeat its actions, and the Model would write different text anyway.
  3. For new work, open Model output on a step while it runs or after it finishes. SMTO saves this text for new Model calls automatically, so newer steps should have it.

What success looks like

  • On a newer step, Model output shows text and offers Download full capture.

If it still fails

  • If new steps also have no saved Model output, select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The model-output endpoint found the request trace but no captured stream for this exact request_id and call_id pair, so there is nothing to replay, copy or download; calls made before capture existed cannot be reconstructed.

What this means

  • Model-output lookup finds no captured stream for the exact request_id/call_id pair. Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.

Why this can happen

  • Model-output lookup finds no captured stream for the exact request_id/call_id pair.

How to diagnose it

  • Verify the exact call identity and capture/retention state without treating absent output as an absent call.

How to fix it

  • No direct repair is available for this occurrence. Use the supported investigation or alternative workflow below.
  • Inspect the retained task trace and receipts for this request instead; GET /api/agent/trace/<request_id>/models/<call_id> only serves existing captures, and new streaming model calls are captured automatically. Capture output for a future call if needed; do not rerun completed operations to reproduce missing diagnostics.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Available task receipts are inspected, and capture for future calls is configured only if needed.

What not to do

  • Do not turn this status into an automatic retry or a new execution request.

Technical notes

  • Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
